title: Solitaire
tagline: A tricky solitaire with a stubborn reserve pile.
teaser: Build the foundations from the reserve, the tableau and the stock. Harder than the solitaire you know, and more satisfying.

manPage.synopsis: canfield — move cards to the foundations; empty the reserve.
manPage.description: Steve Levine’s solitaire for BSD, with later hacking by Steve Feldman, Kirk McKusick, Mikey Olson and Eric Allman.

howToPlay: Deal the layout: a reserve pile, a tableau and the stock.
Build the foundations up by suit from the starting rank.
Empty the reserve and get every card home to win.
